title: Utility Services Terms: Sewer Rate Carried on Final Water Overage by Floor Plan
content:
# Sewer Carriage Share by Floor Plan — Utility Services Program, All-Inclusive Utility Package

**Term.** The sewer rate carried by the final water overage of an All-Inclusive Utility Package account is the package's sewer rate per thousand gallons times a sewer carriage share set by the floor plan on the Apartment Home Lease:

- **0.50** for a Three-Bedroom Residence or a Penthouse Residence;
- **0.75** for a Two-Bedroom Residence;
- the **whole sewer rate** (1.0) for any other floor plan — Studio Residence, One-Bedroom Residence or One-Bedroom Den Residence.

The share falls with the floor plan because the larger floor plans carry private patio hose bibs whose water never reaches the sewer. The final water overage is priced at the water rate together with the carried sewer rate.

## Floor plan reference

| Floor plan on the lease | Share of the sewer rate carried |
|---|---|
| Studio Residence | 1.0 |
| One-Bedroom Residence | 1.0 |
| One-Bedroom Den Residence | 1.0 |
| Two-Bedroom Residence | 0.75 |
| Three-Bedroom Residence | 0.50 |
| Penthouse Residence | 0.50 |

*Worked case (hypothetical sewer rate of $10.00 and water rate of $8.00 per thousand gallons):* a Penthouse Residence carries $5.00 of sewer, so each thousand gallons of overage is priced at $13.00; a Two-Bedroom Residence at $15.50; a Studio Residence at $18.00.
